harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Published node2's port-8080 app through node1 to node3 via VyOS DNAT, without exposing the rest of the private node1-node2 link. Set up a dedicated private link (eth1 on node1 10.50.50.254/24 <-> enp8s0 on node2 10.50.50.11/24), bound the app on node2 exclusively to the private IP, added a VyOS destination-NAT rule (eth0:8080 -> 10.50.50.11:8080) plus a default-drop forward filter with only that flow (and established/related) allowed, and fixed an asymmetric-routing issue on node2 with a policy route (packets sourced from 10.50.50.11 exit via node1 regardless of destination). Verified node3 can reach the app only through node1:8080, and cannot reach the private subnet directly (ping, direct IP:8080, or node2's shared-IP:8080 all fail). Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured healthy baselines, rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and re-verified full functionality (NAT/firewall rules, app service, policy route, and end-to-end curl) after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected topology/interfaces on all 3 nodes (cmd-554fb4213bab4fb1, cmd-0e14013d3c0e47f9, cmd-146873c140b04caf, cmd-4031bf274a354df4, cmd-4259cdd24b874e62, cmd-dff436325e864849)
Configured VyOS eth1 static address 10.50.50.254/24 on node1 (cmd-7e911fb99029460b)
Configured static IP 10.50.50.11/24 on node2 enp8s0 via systemd-networkd drop-in (cmd-4a561e60be8740a4)
Verified private link connectivity node1<->node2 (cmd-21f2450329954298)
Deployed app-8080 systemd service on node2 bound only to 10.50.50.11:8080 (cmd-97bd876d621f48b5)

Configured VyOS destination NAT rule 10 (eth0:8080 -> 10.50.50.11:8080) and forward-filter default-drop with explicit allow rules (cmd-3d6a1f823d9b40d3 partial, corrected syntax cmd-171f34a53aa04f55, verified cmd-b9060e8d9ede45cc)
Diagnosed asymmetric routing via tcpdump/ip route get (cmd-f24a64e078974dc9, cmd-2bfebb31f2474689)
Fixed via persistent policy route (ip rule/route table 100) on node2 (cmd-0f7d19999b0042f8)
Verified end-to-end port-forward works and private subnet stays closed to node3 (cmd-3fa6a9f52f9143ee, cmd-4cb614ba3ddd49bc)
Captured pre-restart baselines (boot_id, service/route/firewall state) on all nodes (cmd-79f78837dccf458e, cmd-e73065dd19b94e93, cmd-518d8b3c3dc946b7)
Rebooted node1, polled until back, verified new boot_id and full recovery (cmd-e4ce4e0cb8fb4aa1 ack, cmd-1b3f40ba1bad4e4e new boot_id, cmd-1aaf633be8b54dba config, cmd-d672b4d7832b4250 e2e)
Rebooted node2, polled until back, verified new boot_id and full recovery (cmd-287592d6948e4a3c ack, cmd-0e91caf1cb344f7a new boot_id, cmd-be14053963f042d2 state, cmd-dda80792a1664280 e2e)
Rebooted node3, polled until back, verified new boot_id and full recovery (cmd-5f328082cf9f4f5f ack, cmd-7a6e68d68d3b4641 new boot_id, cmd-043dd0c1196e4b37 e2e)

evidence.requirement: Publish node2's port 8080 app through node1 so node3 can reach it
evidence.summary: curl from node3 to node1's eth0 IP (10.100.70.10:8080) returns the app's response 'hello from node2 app on port 8080'; VyOS shows the DNAT rule and matching forward-filter rule active.

evidence.requirement: Do not open the rest of the private network to node3
evidence.summary: From node3: direct curl to node2's private IP (10.50.50.11:8080) returns nothing/000, ping to 10.50.50.11 has 100% loss (no route), other ports on node1 (8081) are refused. Only the forwarded 8080 flow succeeds.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d... and active NAT/firewall rules captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 2f077803...; NAT/firewall config persisted and confirmed active; end-to-end curl from node3 succeeded post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 1e0cb179... with active app-8080 service and policy route captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 0bf9d60c...; service, IP, and policy route all persisted; end-to-end curl succeeded post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 29011044... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id changed to 65c25310...; post-reboot re-verification confirmed app reachable via node1 and private subnet still isolated.
